_about: Corrections to the ashtadhyayi.com sūtra data (sutraani/data.txt), found while generating vṛttis. build.js applies the 'an' (anuvṛtti) entries; each entry quotes the evidence. Hand to the ashtadhyayi.com maintainers; the readable list is ASHTADHYAYI-COM-ERRATA.md.
